seoTitle: GTmetrix vs AI Website Audit — Which Should You Use?
metaDescription: Comparing GTmetrix and our free AI Website Audit — what each tool measures, and when to use which one for your website.
intro: GTmetrix is a well-established performance testing tool popular with developers for its detailed waterfall charts and historical performance monitoring. Our AI Website Audit is built for a different audience and a different job — small business owners who want to know, in plain English, what's actually stopping their website from winning more customers.
competitorStrengths: Detailed waterfall charts showing exactly which resources load when and how long each takes
Historical performance monitoring and alerting for tracking changes over time
Test location and device/connection simulation options for developers debugging specific scenarios
Established, developer-trusted tool with a long track record
ourStrengths: No technical knowledge required — every finding is explained in plain English with a clear severity and difficulty rating
Covers the full picture beyond speed: SEO, accessibility, trust, mobile, conversion and local SEO
Estimates real business impact (potential enquiries, visibility improvement) rather than just technical scores
Free branded PDF report and a natural path to professional help fixing what's found
verdict: If you're a developer who needs granular waterfall-level performance debugging, GTmetrix is built exactly for that. If you're a business owner who wants a fast, plain-English answer to "what's wrong with my website and how much is it costing me" across every factor that affects enquiries — not just load time — our free AI Website Audit is the more useful starting point.
